defmodule CleanerCrmSpex.Story845.Criterion7178Spex do
  @moduledoc """
  Story 845 — Report damage, missing items, or unsafe conditions from the job
  Criterion 7178 — Cleaner files a damage report from the job screen
  """

  use CleanerCrmSpex.Case

  alias CleanerCrmSpex.Fixtures

  spex "a cleaner files a damage report directly from the job screen" do
    scenario "cleaner files a damage report from the job screen" do
      given_ "the owner is logged in with an active account", context do
        user = Fixtures.user_fixture()
        scope = Fixtures.user_scope_fixture(user)
        account = Fixtures.account_fixture(scope)
        owner_conn = Fixtures.log_in_user(context.conn, user)

        {:ok,
         Map.merge(context, %{owner_conn: owner_conn, user: user, scope: scope, account: account})}
      end

      given_ "cleaner Ana is logged in on her assigned, in-progress job", context do
        client = Fixtures.client_fixture(context.scope)

        cleaner =
          Fixtures.cleaner_fixture(context.scope, context.account, %{email: "ana@example.com"})

        job =
          Fixtures.job_fixture(context.scope, client, %{
            cleaner_id: cleaner.id,
            status: :in_progress
          })

        conn = Fixtures.log_in_user(build_conn(), cleaner)

        {:ok, Map.merge(context, %{client: client, cleaner: cleaner, job: job, conn: conn})}
      end

      when_ "Ana files a damage report with a description and a photo of the damage", context do
        {:ok, job_live, _html} = live(context.conn, ~p"/field/jobs/#{context.job.id}")

        photo_upload =
          file_input(job_live, "[data-test='incident-photo-upload']", :photo, [
            %{name: "broken_lamp.jpg", content: "photo-bytes", type: "image/jpeg"}
          ])

        render_upload(photo_upload, "broken_lamp.jpg")

        job_live
        |> form("[data-test='incident-report-form']",
          incident: %{
            type: "damage",
            description: "Living room floor lamp is cracked and will not stand upright"
          }
        )
        |> render_submit()

        {:ok, Map.put(context, :job_live, job_live)}
      end

      then_ "the damage report appears on the job screen as filed", context do
        assert has_element?(context.job_live, "[data-test='incident-report-item']")

        assert render(context.job_live) =~
                 "Living room floor lamp is cracked and will not stand upright"

        {:ok, context}
      end

      then_ "the owner sees the filed damage report when reviewing incidents", context do
        {:ok, _review_live, html} = live(context.owner_conn, ~p"/quality")

        assert html =~ "Living room floor lamp is cracked and will not stand upright"

        {:ok, context}
      end
    end
  end
end

  This function is meant to mimic what the user can actually do, so you cannot

  def form(%View{proxy: proxy}, selector, form_data \\ %{}) when is_binary(selector) do
    %Element{proxy: proxy, selector: selector, form_data: form_data}
  end

  @doc """
  Builds a file input for testing uploads within a form.

  Given the form DOM selector, the upload name, and a list of maps of client metadata
  for the upload, the returned file input can be passed to `render_upload/2`.

  Client metadata takes the following form:

    * `:last_modified` - the last modified timestamp
    * `:name` - the name of the file
    * `:content` - the binary content of the file
    * `:size` - the byte size of the content
    * `:type` - the MIME type of the file
    * `:relative_path` - for simulating webkitdirectory metadata
    * `:meta` - optional metadata sent by the client

  ## Examples

      avatar = file_input(lv, "#my-form-id", :avatar, [%{
        last_modified: 1_594_171_879_000,
        name: "myfile.jpeg",
        content: File.read!("myfile.jpg"),
        size: 1_396_009,
        type: "image/jpeg"
      }])

      assert render_upload(avatar, "myfile.jpeg") =~ "100%"
  """
  defmacro file_input(view, form_selector, name, entries) do
    quote bind_quoted: [view: view, selector: form_selector, name: name, entries: entries] do
      require Phoenix.ChannelTest
      builder = fn -> Phoenix.ChannelTest.connect(Phoenix.LiveView.Socket, %{}) end
      Phoenix.LiveViewTest.__file_input__(view, selector, name, entries, builder)
    end
  end

  @doc false
  def __file_input__(view, selector, name, entries, builder) do
    cid = find_cid!(view, selector)

    for entry <- entries do
      content = entry[:content]
      size = entry[:size]

      if content && size && byte_size(content) != size do
        raise ArgumentError, """
        entry content size must match provided size.

        By default the content size is calculated using byte_size/1, so you
        rarely need to provide the size option yourself unless you are testing
        for misbehaving clients.
        """
      end
    end

SexySpex provides a framework for writing executable specifications that serve

@doc false
  def __file_input__(view, selector, name, entries, builder) do
    cid = find_cid!(view, selector)

    for entry <- entries do
      content = entry[:content]
      size = entry[:size]

      if content && size && byte_size(content) != size do
        raise ArgumentError, """
        entry content size must match provided size.

        By default the content size is calculated using byte_size/1, so you
        rarely need to provide the size option yourself unless you are testing
        for misbehaving clients.
        """
      end
    end

    case Phoenix.LiveView.Channel.fetch_upload_config(view.pid, name, cid) do
      {:ok, %{external: false}} ->
        start_upload_client(builder, view, selector, name, entries, cid)

      {:ok, %{external: func}} when is_function(func) ->
        start_external_upload_client(view, selector, name, entries, cid)

      :error ->
        raise "no uploads allowed for #{name}"
    end
  end

    lazy = call(view, {:get_lazy, view.id})

    with {:ok, form} <- DOM.maybe_one(lazy, selector),
         [form] <- DOM.to_tree(form) do
      [cid | _] = DOM.targets_from_node(lazy, form)
      cid

defmodule CleanerCrmWeb.FieldLive.IncidentFormComponent do @moduledoc """ Files a damage, missing-item, or unsafe-condition report from the job screen, and lists reports already filed for this job. A photo is required for damage/missing-item reports (enforced by `CleanerCrm.Quality.file_incident_report/3`'s own changeset, not duplicated here); unsafe-condition reports need none. Once filed, a report is immutable — this component never offers an edit or delete affordance. ## Assigns | Assign | Type | Required | Description | |---------------|-------------|----------|------------------------------| | id | string | yes | LiveComponent DOM id | | current_scope | `Scope.t()` | yes | caller scope | | job | `Job.t()` | yes | the job being reported on | ## Dependencies - `CleanerCrm.Quality` """ use CleanerCrmWeb, :live_component alias CleanerCrm.Quality alias CleanerCrm.Repo @impl true def render(assigns) do ~H"""

Report an Issue

<.form for={@form} id={"#{@id}-form"} data-test="incident-report-form" phx-target={@myself} phx-change="validate" phx-submit="save" > <.input field={@form[:type]} type="select" label="Type" prompt="Select a type" options={[ {"Damage", "damage"}, {"Missing item", "missing_item"}, {"Unsafe condition", "unsafe_condition"} ]} /> <.input field={@form[:description]} type="textarea" label="Description" />
Photo (required for damage or a missing item) <.live_file_input upload={@uploads.photo} />

{msg}

<.button phx-disable-with="Filing...">File Report
  • {report.type}

    {report.description}

    {report.cleaner.email}

    {Calendar.strftime(report.filed_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")}

""" end @impl true def mount(socket) do {:ok, allow_upload(socket, :photo, accept: ~w(.jpg .jpeg .png), max_entries: 1)} end @impl true def update(assigns, socket) do {:ok, socket |> assign(assigns) |> assign_new(:form, fn -> blank_form() end) |> assign_new(:incident_reports, fn -> load_incident_reports(assigns.current_scope, assigns.job) end)} end defp blank_form, do: to_form(%{"type" => nil, "description" => nil}, as: :incident) defp load_incident_reports(scope, job) do scope |> Quality.list_incident_reports() |> Enum.filter(&(&1.job_id == job.id)) end @impl true def handle_event("validate", %{"incident" => params}, socket) do {:noreply, assign(socket, :form, to_form(params, as: :incident))} end @impl true def handle_event("save", %{"incident" => params}, socket) do attrs = maybe_put_photo(params, socket) case Quality.file_incident_report(socket.assigns.current_scope, socket.assigns.job, attrs) do {:ok, report} -> report = Repo.preload(report, :cleaner) {:noreply, socket |> assign(:incident_reports, [report | socket.assigns.incident_reports]) |> assign(:form, blank_form())} {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset} -> {:noreply, assign(socket, :form, to_form(changeset, as: :incident))} end end defp maybe_put_photo(params, socket) do case socket.assigns.uploads.photo.entries do [] -> params _entries -> [storage_key] = consume_uploaded_entries(socket, :photo, fn %{path: path}, entry -> {:ok, store_upload!(path, entry)} end) Map.put(params, "photo", %{ "storage_key" => storage_key, "upload_state" => "uploaded", "captured_at" => DateTime.utc_now() }) end end defp store_upload!(path, entry) do dest_dir = Path.join([:code.priv_dir(:cleaner_crm), "static", "uploads"]) File.mkdir_p!(dest_dir) filename = "#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}-#{entry.client_name}" File.cp!(path, Path.join(dest_dir, filename)) "/uploads/#{filename}" end defp photo_errors(%{source: %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset}) do changeset.errors |> Keyword.get_values(:photo) |> Enum.map(fn {msg, _opts} -> "A photo " <> msg <> "." end) end defp photo_errors(_form), do: [] end

Fixed and reported to team-lead. Summary:

**File changed:** `/Users/johndavenport/Documents/github/cleaner_crm/lib/cleaner_crm_web/live/field_live/incident_form_component.ex` (job.ex was untouched — not needed).

**Root cause confirmed:** LiveView's client JS (`view.ts` `pushInput`) throws `"form events require the input to be inside a form"` when `inputEl.form` is null, which happens whenever a file input isn't a descendant of a `<form>` element. The `live_file_input` was sitting in a plain `<div>` outside the `<.form>`, so in a real browser the upload channel never activated — matching the reported symptom exactly.

**Fix:** moved the `live_file_input` (and its `data-test="incident-photo-upload"` wrapper, plus `phx-target={@myself}` needed for the test harness's component-id resolution) inside the `<.form>`. Added `phx-change="validate"` on the form and a new `handle_event("validate", ...)` clause for the standard LiveView upload-tracking pattern. All existing data-test attributes and event names were preserved.

**Verification, all green:**
- `MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors` — clean
